passwordPolicy: length(12) and notUsername and notEmail and passwordHistory(5)

realm.name: MERCHANT
realm.description: Hospital staff: sees and manages only their hospital (needs the mid attribute)

realm.name: OPS
realm.description: Payment operations: all hospitals, reconciliation, ledger
